abilities.name: forewarn
abilities.effect: Reveals the opponents' strongest move upon entering battle.

kanto.flavorText: When it locks eyes with an enemy, it will use a mix of PSI moves such as HYPNOSIS and CONFUSION.

original-johto.flavorText: The longer it swings its pendulum, the longer the effects of its hypnosis last.

hoenn.flavorText: The arcing movement and glitter of the pendulum in a HYPNO’s hand lull the foe into deep hypnosis. While searching for prey, it polishes the pendulum.

original-sinnoh.flavorText: Seeing its swinging pendulum can induce sleep in three seconds, even in someone who just woke up.

extended-sinnoh.flavorText: Seeing its swinging pendulum can induce sleep in three seconds, even in someone who just woke up.

updated-johto.flavorText: Always holding a pendulum that it swings at a steady rhythm, it causes drowsiness in anyone nearby.

original-unova.flavorText: Seeing its swinging pendulum can induce sleep in three seconds, even in someone who just woke up.

updated-unova.flavorText: Seeing its swinging pendulum can induce sleep in three seconds, even in someone who just woke up.

kalos.flavorText: Seeing its swinging pendulum can induce sleep in three seconds, even in someone who just woke up.

updated-hoenn.flavorText: Hypno holds a pendulum in its hand. The arcing movement and glitter of the pendulum lull the foe into a deep state of hypnosis. While this Pokémon searches for prey, it polishes the pendulum.

original-alola.flavorText: As a matter of course, it makes anyone it meets fall asleep and has a taste of their dreams. Anyone having a good dream, it carries off.

updated-alola.flavorText: There are some Hypno that assist doctors with patients who can’t sleep at night in hospitals.

letsgo-kanto.flavorText: Avoid eye contact if you come across one. It will try to put you to sleep by using its pendulum.
